BETA Close X Currys PLC has purchased 1,399,612 of its own ordinary shares for cancellation on March 30, 2026, at prices ranging from 118.10p to 120.00p per share. Following this transaction, the company will have 1,099,269,065 ordinary shares in issue, with no shares held in treasury. This updated total represents the company's total voting rights. No Ordinary Shares are held in treasury. This number represents the total voting rights in the Company and may be used by shareholders as the denominator for the calculations by which they can determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in the Company under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
